Messages.Author: Baaliprimogen
Messages.Body:
Hi
In the upcoming storyline I am considering playing with Menele and his
advancement. Now I don't think I will play Brujah, but some Liabon
clan. Now my question is: Should I use 3 copies of menele (one of them
adv.) and stay with a 12 card crypt size. Or should I increase my
Crypt to 16 and use 4 copies of Menele. Which of the two gives me
biggest chance of drawing him on my first round?

Messages.Author: Orpheus
Messages.Body:


When you need a vamp badly, 13/4 seems nice to me.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


3/12 = 75% chance of seeing him in the opening 4.
4/16 = 73%

Messages.Author: Baaliprimogen
Messages.Body:


Thanks
Hum. Then a 3/12 crypt would prob be the best.

Messages.Author: John P.
Messages.Body:


4 of 13 (as compared to 4 of 12) increases chance of seeing ONLY 1
copy (+1.7%)
while increasing the chance of seeing none (+2.5%). Seems like a poor
trade off

Messages.Author: bwross
Messages.Body:
On Oct 14, 11:14 am, Baaliprimogen <vegardki...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Thanks
> Hum. Then a 3/12 crypt would prob be the best.

Yeah, the general rule is:

If you increase the size of the deck/crypt, you need a higher ratio of
your key card to maintain the same level of consistency.

Corollary:

To maximize consistency, minimize the size of your deck/crypt where
possible.

Brent Ross
